claims: Spectrum SportsNet LA is the home for most Dodgers games in the local market.
Fubo, YouTube TV, and Hulu + Live TV offer access to local and national Dodgers games.
MLB.TV allows streaming of Dodgers games not televised in the local area.
Dodgers games are occasionally on MLB Network, FOX, or ESPN.
The MLB App offers in-market streaming for authorized subscribers.
Spectrum subscribers can stream Dodgers games via the MLB app
